directions: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on the recent development in their hometown. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
My hometown has witnessed remarkable development in recent years. To begin with, the infrastructure has been greatly improved. New roads have been built, which makes commuting much more convenient. For example, the expressway connecting my hometown to the neighboring city has reduced the travel time significantly.

In addition, the local economy has also thrived. There are more factories and businesses, providing numerous job opportunities for the local people. Many young people who used to work in big cities are now willing to return home to start their own careers.

Furthermore, the environment has been well-protected. The local government has launched a series of environmental protection projects. The rivers are cleaner, and the air is fresher. Parks and green spaces have been created, offering a better living environment for residents.

In conclusion, the development in my hometown is obvious and positive. I believe it will continue to progress and become an even better place to live in the future.
